description: Rename a collection, set whether it is commercial, or archive or unarchive it. A rename or commercial change needs its current revision; archived alone does not and is safe to repeat. Archived collections are hidden from list_collections and search_collections unless you ask for them. A collection containing CC BY-NC tracks cannot be made commercial.

archived.description: true archives, false unarchives. Needs no revision when sent alone.

title: Update a collection
